collection.title: Mercedes-Benz CLA Coupe 2016 to 2019 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz CLA Coupe 2016 - 2019 (117) model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Specific Fit Mercedes-Benz arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. PLEASE NOTE - THE VF923 IS A SPECIAL ORDER PART - PLEASE ALLOW AN EXTRA 2-3 WORKING DAYS.
